full_page.content:
1928, March 10 & April 11
The following is the faithful transcription of the handwritten letter with messages on Seraphic Mass Association cards written by the Ser- vant of God, Father Solanus Casey, OFM Cap.
St. Bonaventure's Monastery
1740 Mt. Elliott Ave.
Detroit, Mich.
March 10, 1928
Mrs. M. Bennett 191 South Ave. Verdun Que.
My Dear Mrs. Bennett: -
Thank God you and Mr. Bennett are well. I do not know if I answered your last letters or not. I very seldom (APR 11 1928) catch up with my letters - I guess that's what I wanted to tell you a month ago. I've had the "grippe" these two weeks. It is gone now thank God but it has left me with bronchitis which is anything but pleasant Ella's address: Mrs. Ella Traynor. 1811 East Spring St. Seattle, Washington
Please pardon delay Joyful Easter to All !!! Praised Be Jesus Christ
(no signature) 1927 Sept. 28th,
Mr. and Mrs. M.H. Bennett and Family
"Come to me all ye that labor and I will refresh you" Sept. 28th 1927, God Bless you all !.... See that you Save your Souls! Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap
Praised Be Jesus!
1942 Apr. 22
Mrs. Margaret Bennett - for speedy recovery - Apr. 22, 1942, God bless you Mrs. Bennett. Keep Courage and pray for the conversion of the rest of us ... Fr. Sol. -- of course including Mike B. Praised be Jesus .... Fr. So).
Original in possession of : Mrs. Carmel Miller 1231 Moffat Ave. Verdun, P.Quebec, Canada H4H 121
